name: GoKwik
shortInfo: Gokwik is an eCommerce enablement platform that offers solutions to eCommerce businesses.
brief: Gokwik is an eCommerce enablement platform that offers solutions to meet the needs of eCommerce businesses.
about: GoKwik Connector enables streaming relevant GoKwik Settlement data into a user determined warehouse. This data enables merchants/ eCommerce businesses on GoKwik’s network to access settlement data, ensuring efficient and accurate reconciliation. This sync happens in an automated manner after a user has configured relevant pipelines and determined an update frequency.
availableData:
[Settlement Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/gokwik/pipelines/settlement-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the Settlement report for the specified period from the GoKwik Platform.
